```{r}
library(fixest)
library(Matrix)
```

# Generate fake data and format it in different ways

Step 1: Generate the fake data

```{r}
I <- 30L
J <- 50L
D <- 1000L
vocab_I <- paste0("I_cat", 1:I)
vocab_J <- paste0("J_cat", 1:J)

N_total <- 10000L

get_powerlaw <- function(no_cats){
  prenorm = 1/(1:no_cats)
  prenorm / sum(prenorm)
}

set.seed(2025)
doc_idx <- sample(D, N_total, replace = TRUE) 
cats_slot1 <- sample(I, N_total, replace = TRUE, prob = get_powerlaw(I))
cats_slot2 <- sample(J, N_total, replace = TRUE, prob = get_powerlaw(J))
n_obs <- sample(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L), N_total, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.25, 0.15, 0.1, 0.1))
n_obs[1] <- 10L
n_obs[5] <- 20L
offsets_perdoc <- ceiling(runif(D, min = 30, max = 80)) 
offsets <- offsets_perdoc[doc_idx]
```

Step 2: Format the fake data as a DF

```{r}
data_fake <- data.frame(doc = doc_idx,
    slot1 = factor(vocab_I[cats_slot1], levels = vocab_I),
    slot2 = factor(vocab_J[cats_slot1], levels = vocab_J),
    n = n_obs,
    offsets = offsets)
```

# Create the negative binomial model

```{r}
# phi <- 1.0 / alpha_param 
# eta <- X_sparse %*% params
# mu <- exp(X_sparse %*% params + T_offset_vec)

# (-lgamma(n + phi) +
#   lgamma(phi) + lgamma(n + 1) -
#   phi * log(phi) -
#   n * (X_sparse %*% params + T_offset_vec) + 
#   n * log(exp(X_sparse %*% params + T_offset_vec) + phi) +
#   phi * log(exp(X_sparse %*% params + T_offset_vec) + mu) )

```

```{r}
library(fixest)
gravity_negbin = fenegbin(n ~ slot1 + slot2 + slot1:slot2, data_fake, offset = log(data_fake$offset))
```
